name: Paris Romance Tour
description: A week-long romantic escape through the City of Light, combining sunset cruises on the Seine with candlelit dinners in Montmartre bistros. The itinerary includes a private guided tour of the Louvre, a picnic beneath the Eiffel Tower, a day trip to the gardens of Versailles and a cooking class focused on classic French pastries. Accommodation is a boutique hotel near the Tuileries Garden.

name: Bali Beach Getaway
description: Ten relaxing days on the southern coast of Bali, split between the lively beaches of Kuta and quieter coves on the Bukit Peninsula. Highlights include surfing lessons for beginners, a sunset visit to Uluwatu Temple with a traditional Kecak fire dance, snorkelling trips to Nusa Penida and a full-day spa package. The stay is at a beachfront villa with a private pool and daily breakfast.

name: Tokyo Cherry Blossom Trip
description: Timed to coincide with peak sakura season, this trip explores the best cherry blossom viewing spots in Tokyo, including Ueno Park, Shinjuku Gyoen and the illuminated riverbanks of Meguro. The plan also covers a visit to the Tokyo Skytree, an evening food tour in Asakusa, a traditional tea ceremony and a day excursion to Kamakura to see the Great Buddha and its coastal temples.

name: Sydney Harbour Adventure
description: Two weeks discovering Sydney and its surroundings, starting with a climb of the Harbour Bridge and a backstage tour of the Opera House. The itinerary continues with a coastal walk from Bondi to Coogee, a ferry ride to Manly, wine tasting in the Hunter Valley and a three-day excursion to the Blue Mountains. Accommodation is a harbour-view apartment in The Rocks district.

name: Rome Art and History Escape
description: Six days immersed in the history of the Eternal City, with skip-the-line access to the Colosseum, the Roman Forum and the Vatican Museums including the Sistine Chapel. Afternoons are reserved for wandering the cobbled lanes of Trastevere, tossing a coin into the Trevi Fountain and enjoying gelato near the Pantheon. A guided evening walk explores Baroque piazzas and hidden courtyards.

name: Singapore Food Trail
description: A short but flavour-packed break focused on the culinary diversity of Singapore. Daily guided tastings cover hawker centres such as Lau Pa Sat and Maxwell, Peranakan specialities in Katong and the spice markets of Little India. The trip also includes an evening at Gardens by the Bay for the light show, a rooftop dinner overlooking Marina Bay and a hands-on chilli crab masterclass.

name: Dubai Desert Safari
description: A festive week in Dubai over the Christmas holidays, combining modern city sightseeing with traditional Arabian experiences. Highlights include the observation deck of the Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Fountain show, an abra ride across Dubai Creek to the gold and spice souks and an overnight desert safari with dune bashing, camel rides, falconry and a Bedouin-style dinner under the stars.

name: London Royal Heritage Tour
description: A week exploring the royal and historic side of London, starting with the Changing of the Guard at Buckingham Palace and a tour of the Tower of London and the Crown Jewels. Further visits include Westminster Abbey, Kensington Palace and a day trip to Windsor Castle. Evenings feature a West End musical, afternoon tea at a classic hotel and a dinner cruise on the Thames.

name: Bangkok Temple Discovery
description: Two weeks of cultural discovery in Bangkok and central Thailand, beginning with the Grand Palace, Wat Pho and its reclining Buddha and Wat Arun at sunrise. The trip includes a longtail boat tour through the Thonburi canals, a visit to the floating market at Damnoen Saduak, a day trip to the ancient capital of Ayutthaya and a traditional Thai massage course.

name: Paris Fashion Week Experience
description: An exclusive eight-day stay during Paris Fashion Week, with access to selected runway shows and designer showroom events. The programme includes a personal styling session, a private shopping tour along Avenue Montaigne and Rue Saint-Honoré, a visit to the Yves Saint Laurent museum and dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant. Accommodation is a luxury hotel overlooking the Seine near the Musée d'Orsay.

name: New York City Lights
description: A five-day Independence Day break in New York City, featuring the fireworks over the East River, a Broadway show and panoramic views from the Empire State Building. Daytime plans include cycling through Central Park, visiting the Metropolitan Museum of Art, walking the High Line and taking the ferry to the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island. The stay is in a Midtown hotel.

name: London Business and Leisure
description: A compact trip combining client meetings in the City of London with leisure time in the evenings. The plan includes a co-working membership near Liverpool Street, a networking dinner at the Sky Garden and a private tour of the financial district. Free time covers the Tate Modern, Borough Market and a Premier League match, with a stay at a five-star hotel in Shoreditch.

name: Bali Wellness Retreat
description: A three-week wellness retreat in the green hills around Ubud, designed to restore body and mind. Each day starts with sunrise yoga and meditation, followed by healthy organic meals and Balinese healing treatments. Excursions include the Tegallalang rice terraces, the Sacred Monkey Forest, a purification ritual at Tirta Empul temple and a guided sunrise trek up the Mount Batur volcano.

name: New York Skyline Break
description: A New Year celebration in Manhattan, with access to the festivities in Times Square and a gala dinner on the night of 31 December. The week also features ice skating at Rockefeller Center, the holiday windows on Fifth Avenue, a helicopter tour over the skyline, a jazz evening in Harlem and visits to the Museum of Modern Art and the 9/11 Memorial.

name: Dubai Luxury Escape
description: A short luxury getaway on Palm Jumeirah, ideal for recharging over a long weekend. The stay includes a sea-view suite at a beach resort, a private yacht cruise along Dubai Marina, a spa day with a traditional hammam treatment and dinner at an underwater restaurant. An optional afternoon visit to the Museum of the Future and the Dubai Mall aquarium completes the trip.
